mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO study_time_records (id, daily_report_id, subject_id, minutes) VALUES
(#{record.id}, #{record.dailyReportId}, #{record.subjectId}, #{record.minutes})
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS subjectId, s.name AS subjectName, SUM(str.minutes) AS minutes FROM study_time_records str JOIN daily_reports dr ON dr.id = str.daily_report_id JOIN subjects s ON s.id = str.subject_id WHERE dr.student_id = #{studentId} GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.display_order ORDER BY s.display_order ASC
